maddeler.e:
تباغضت (form VI)
# تَبَاغَضْتُ (tabāḡaḍtu) /ta.baː.ɣadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
# تَبَاغَضْتَ (tabāḡaḍta) /ta.baː.ɣadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
# تَبَاغَضْتِ (tabāḡaḍti) /ta.baː.ɣadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
# تَبَاغَضَتْ (tabāḡaḍat) /ta.baː.ɣa.dˤat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
